description: One single YOUNG rose-leaf garden tree, a slender sapling for a melancholic ruined sky-garden action RPG. Same beautifully hand-clustered native pixel art material language as the reference mature tree, but genuinely young anatomy: narrow tapering blue-slate bark trunk with a subtle pale bark lit edge, three upward-forking slender branches, a small irregular open crown of dusty rose and ash-mauve leaves. Scattered three-dimensional leaf clusters with intentional shading and visible daylight gaps between them, no broad flat horizontal strips, no umbrella canopy, no bonsai mature-tree silhouette. Rooted base connects naturally to a slim 14-pixel-wide exposed root foot. Three-quarter overhead orthographic view. Upper-left daylight, blue-grey shaded bark and restrained rose leaves. Entire young tree visible inside a 48x64 native canvas; occupied shape about 32 pixels wide and 46 pixels tall, crown between y12 and y36, slender trunk continues to y54, root foot reaches y59 and leaves 4 transparent rows below. Trunk meets the ground around x25. No ground mound, no pedestal, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no text. Exact native 1px density, hard opaque-or-transparent pixel edges, clean clusters, small restrained palette. Do not shrink a full mature tree, do not add a glow.
